scripts.dev:seed: wrangler d1 migrations apply topbarz-voting --local && node scripts/load-tracks.mjs --env local && node scripts/load-photos.mjs --env local && node scripts/load-beats.mjs --env local --folder "$HOME/topbarz-source/drive/Test tracks"
scripts.migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply topbarz-voting-preview --remote --env preview
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run migrate:preview && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name topbarz-voting --branch staging --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:production: npm run migrate:production && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name topbarz-voting --branch main --commit-dirty=true
